title: Classic German Pear Strudel with Zesty Topping
description: A traditional German dessert featuring layers of flaky pastry, sweet pears, and a tangy zesty topping.

ingredients.name: Zesty topping
ingredients.notes: see below for zesty topping recipe

instructions: Roll out the pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced pears and cinnamon. Mix well to coat.
Place the pastry on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Arrange the pear mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold the pastry over the pear mixture, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with melted butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
While the strudel is baking, prepare the zesty topping by mixing the powdered sugar and vanilla in a small bowl.
Remove the strudel from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the zesty topping over the warm strudel.
